question: Find the distinct full names of club officers (not regular members) who attended events with more than 20 attendees and also submitted at least one approved expense.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m."XCL_035", m."XCL_036"
FROM member AS m
WHERE m."XCL_038" != 'Member'
  AND m."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT a."XCL_002"
    FROM attendance AS a
    WHERE a."XCL_001" IN (
      SELECT a2."XCL_001"
      FROM attendance AS a2
      GROUP BY a2."XCL_001"
      HAVING COUNT(*) > 20
    )
  )
  AND m."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT ex."XCL_022"
    FROM expense AS ex
    WHERE ex."XCL_021" = 'true'
  )

    SELECT ex."XCL_022"
    FROM expense AS ex
    WHERE ex."XCL_021" = 'true'
  )
